claims: Official listing identifies Couture as a Prestige preset; View demo frame routed to https://prestige-theme-couture.myshopify.com/
limits: Theme Store feature and marketing copy is vendor-authored.

observations: Official Shopify Prestige:Couture listing View demo opened the matching prestige-theme-couture.myshopify.com storefront.
Luxury apparel homepage uses free-shipping banner, HOME/SHOP/BLOG/ABOUT/PRESETS navigation and a collection hero linking Dresses and Tops.

Modules include Weekly Selection with color cards, collection tiles, brand and sustainability storytelling, Shop the Look, press/blog content, featured product with variants/size, boutique information, service/pledge icons and newsletter.
Brand, sustainability and service statements are merchant content and were not independently verified.
Dresses collection shows 31 products and collection intro copy.
Controls include sort-by and filters for Availability, Color, Size and Price; product cards expose color swatches, review cues and sale prices.
No filter, sort, swatch, layout or product control was activated.
Edie Cascade Wrap Mini Dress Black PDP shows sale price $159, color Black, size options XS/S/M/L, size-chart control and 4 in stock.
The page includes four product gallery images, quantity control, Add to Cart/Buy It Now, ready-to-ship and eco-friendliness copy, shipping/returns accordions, complementary and related products.
No size/color/quantity, accordions, purchase or other product controls were activated; inventory, price, rating and sustainability claims remain unverified.
Cart is empty and offers Continue Shopping to all collections.
Footer includes newsletter, social links, Australian store service and shipping/returns/payment copy.
No cart or checkout action was performed.

limits: No shopper actions, screenshots, viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance tests; merchant claims unverified.
